Cc: Finance Ops <payops@orchidtech.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orchid Tech bank details and onboarding docs

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the kickoff call earlier. As requested, please find our banking evidence and tax form attached to activate Orchid Tech as a vendor for Redwood payments. Key details below for quick reference: 

- Bank: Meridian National Bank
- Account type: Checking
- Account ending: ****4321
- Routing (ACH): 111000025
- Wire routing (Fedwire): 021000021

Attached: bank_letter.pdf (bank verification letter), w9_orchid.pdf (W-9).

A couple of asks we have while you complete activation: 
1) Please confirm the remittance CSV schema Redwood expects (PO vs invoice number mapping) so we can format our payables export.
2) Do you require a micro-deposit verification or an ACH pre-note? We can do either — we initiated a small micro-deposit test yesterday and can confirm amount if that helps.
3) First scheduled invoice: Orchid will submit the initial invoice once vendor status is active; expected payment window is Net 30 from invoice receipt.

If you need anything else (additional bank letter with company registration stamp, ACH authorization form), let me know and I’ll get it over.

Best,
Lena Park
Head of Finance, Orchid Tech
Attachments: bank_letter.pdf, w9_orchid.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orchid Tech bank details and onboarding docs

Thanks Lena — appreciate the fast turnaround and for including the W-9. Quick notes/questions from our side: 

- Remittance format: our Finance team prefers a CSV with columns: PO_NUMBER, INVOICE_NUMBER, INVOICE_DATE, AMOUNT, REMIT_NOTES. Can you confirm Orchid can export that mapping? If you need a sample file we can share one.
- Micro-deposit: we prefer the micro-deposit flow for ACH activation. Please confirm the exact amount sent and the deposit date so we can reconcile it on our end.
- PO mapping: For the first purchase we plan to issue PO RDW-2026-0915-01 — please map that PO into your invoice so our payables system matches automatically.

Next steps: Priya (cc’d) will own the vendor record creation once we have the bank verification. Jordan will handle PO issuance and will confirm the payment schedule once the vendor record is active.

Can you confirm the micro-deposit details and attach a sample remittance CSV? If you prefer, upload to the shared Drive link and we’ll pull it from there.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Lena Park <lena@orchidtech.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:47:00 -07:00

Marcus —

Confirming the micro-deposit details: a test deposit of $0.17 USD was sent on 2026-09-14 and should appear on your bank statement as "ORCHID TEST". Please let me know once you see it and I will mark the account as active on our side.

I attached a remittance_sample.csv to show our export format. The CSV includes a sample PO column (we added a header "PO_REF"). If Redwood needs different column names, we can rename fields programmatically — just share the exact header names and we’ll regenerate.

Attachments: remittance_sample.csv

Also confirming: we are happy to accept a single wire payment or split by PO — whichever fits Redwood's payables practice. Our AR team prefers a single payment per invoice to reduce reconciliation work.

Best,
Lena
(Orchid Finance)
Attachments: remittance_sample.csv

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>

Lena —

Thanks, we saw the $0.17 micro-deposit this morning and completed the verification. Vendor record has been created in our payables system under Redwood vendor ID RWD-V-3287. Next steps and confirmation below: 

- PO issued: RDW-2026-0915-01 (Jordan will attach the PO PDF in a follow-up).
- First payment: we plan to schedule a wire for 2026-10-01 (Net 30 from invoice; please submit invoice upon activation).
- Remittance mapping: Redwood will accept the attached remittance_sample.csv format; we will map your PO_REF to PO_NUMBER in our ingestion. Please use PO_REF on your invoices to ensure auto-apply.
- Evidence stored: bank_letter.pdf and W-9 are saved to our vendor folder (link above).

Action items: 
- Lena: please confirm when Orchid has submitted the first invoice against RDW-2026-0915-01.
- Priya: create vendor record RWD-V-3287 in Oracle Payables and confirm once enabled for payments.
- Jordan: send PO PDF to Orchid and tag the PO in Coupa (if required).

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Welcome aboard.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
